name: Game Expression and Representational Cognition: The Designer’s Lived Experience of the World and Its Articulation Through Play
desc: It focuses on how game designers understand and conceptualize games, rather than on how to make games enjoyable.
descZh: 聚焦于设计师如何理解游戏，而非如何让游戏好玩。
detail: This theory emphasizes the designer’s active expression of emotion and personal experience as a creator, rather than a mere technical presentation. At the same time, the theory posits that games serve as a mode of human cognition of the world. It shifts the design perspective away from the player or conventional game design principles toward the designer themselves, focusing on the designer’s cognitive and mental processes during game creation, as well as the ways in which such emotions and personal experiences are articulated and expressed through the medium of electronic games.
detailZh: 本理论强调设计师作为创作者的情感与个人体验的主动表达，而非单纯的技术呈现。同时本理论认为游戏作为人类认知世界的方式，将设计思路从玩家或游戏设计原理转移到设计师本人，聚焦于设计师在设计游戏时的思维活动，以及如何将这种情感或个人体验通过电子游戏进行表达。

name: Product of human cognitive processes (Basic Knowledge)
desc: Games are the direct product of the human thinking and cognitive processes, rather than serving merely as media or neutral carriers.
descZh: 游戏是人类思维和认知过程的直接产物，而不仅仅是作为媒介或中立的载体。
detail: Recognizing this statement is the prerequisite for understanding the entire 'Game Expression and Representational Cognition' theory. All subsequent design practices and theoretical knowledge are developed upon this foundational premise. Throughout human history, people have come to know the world and shape societies through playing games. Games are immaterial and stem from the most primordial impulses within living organisms.
detailZh: 认同本条内容是理解整个’游戏表达与表征认知‘理论的前提，所有后续设计和知识内容均是基于本条知识所展开。在人类历史上，人们通过玩游戏来认知世界，通过玩游戏来塑造社会。游戏是非物质的，属于生物体内最原始的冲动。

name: Ailurus OS
desc: Local-first AI desktop workbench. Electron shell + React/Vite UI + Python Flask agent runtime with a pluggable app ecosystem.
descZh: 本地优先的AI桌面工作台。Electron桌面壳 + React/Vite界面 + Python Flask智能体运行时，支持插件化应用生态。
detail: Local-first AI desktop workbench (codename: Machiavelli) — a lightweight "desktop OS" experience. Electron desktop shell handles windows, tray & dialogs; React + Vite drives the renderer UI; Python Flask powers the local AI/Agent runtime and tool orchestration. Apps are pluggable sub-applications under apps/, each with its own frontend, Python backend, and capability manifest (ailurus.json). Supports LLM-based agent routing, one-click dev setup, and .ail package distribution.
detailZh: 本地优先的AI桌面工作台（代号：Machiavelli）——轻量级“桌面操作系统”体验。Electron负责桌面壳与系统集成（窗口、托盘、对话框）；React + Vite驱动渲染界面；Python Flask提供本地AI/Agent运行时与工具编排。应用为可插拔子程序，每个应用包含前端、Python后端和能力清单（ailurus.json）。支持基于LLM的智能体路由调度、一键开发环境搭建，以及.ail格式的应用包分发。

name: EmbodiChain
desc: End-to-end GPU-accelerated Embodied AI framework by DexForce. I built the OptiX 8 real-time ray tracing renderer.
descZh: 跨维科技端到端GPU加速具身智能框架。我负责基于OptiX 8的实时光追渲染模块。
detail: End-to-end GPU-accelerated Embodied AI framework by DexForce. I built the OptiX 8 real-time ray tracing renderer — multi-camera parallel pipeline on warp-lang, plus HPC module architecture design.
detailZh: 跨维科技端到端GPU加速具身智能框架。我负责基于OptiX 8的实时光追渲染模块——基于warp-lang的多相机并行渲染管线与HPC模块架构设计。
role: OptiX 8 RT renderer & HPC module architecture
roleZh: OptiX 8 光追渲染器 & HPC模块架构
